title: Pplr's dev/opt/brew switch is its own Rust copy of devbin's contract and differs from devbin's; adopt devbin's one approach
body:
## Source

Recorded by pplr-vc at hv's word, from devbin-vc's report of 2026-11-06 (devbin-vc reviewed it at 08:23Z by its own `date -u`). It is recorded for remediation later: this record changes no code.

## Rulings (hv, 2026-11-06, in devbin-vc's session)

- devbin's dev/opt/brew approach is the canonical one for a Homebrew'd Rust/macOS CLI. Pipeliner is adopting it, and every project uses it, with every difference removed.
- devbin's core carries it, filed as devbin#0326 (devbin 3b3a0806) for devbin's next release.
- Corrected by hv before 09:41Z (by devbin-vc's `date -u`), and confirmed by hv in pplr-vc's session: the publish and the switch are devbin's own verbs, run in the project's checkout, never the tool's. In hv's words: "This should obviously ALWAYS be 'bin/devbin use' not '{{cli}} use'. This is a devbin feature, not part of the pplr, cldr, or ccusage verbs!" devbin#0326 carries the correction since devbin 7ca2e17f.
- The end state for every devbin project, from devbin-vc, whom hv put in charge of the use fix across Pplr, Cldr and Ccusage: the dev/opt/brew switch is `bin/devbin use` and the opt publish is `bin/devbin install`, both run in the checkout; the binary's `--version` prints T4's line; no tool has a `use`, `install` or `version` verb for this; and `bin/devbin doctor` checks the switch and the line. It all arrives with devbin#0326.

## Symptom

Pplr implements devbin's dev/opt/brew contract (devbin's `docs/dev-opt-brew.md`, T1 to T5 and T8) a second time, by hand, in Rust. devbin's own implementation is `lib/cmd/use` with `lib/install`, in bash. One contract has two implementations, and they already differ, so a maintainer meets a different switch in each tool, and every fix has to be made twice.

## Where (Pplr at 64794b6, devbin at c617ed98)

Pplr's copy was added at fed44e6 (2026-11-02 16:27Z, "ST0002 WP03: install, the manifest, the tree, the version line and use"). The spans are the index's at 64794b6.

- Publish and install: `publish` (`src/install.rs:204-287`) and `install` (`:290-368`).
- The manifest: `Manifest::render` (`:81-92`), which writes T3's header.
- The tree: `kind` (`:102-110`).
- The version line: `version_line` (`:134-143`).
- The verbs: `install`, `use` and `version` in the command table (`src/cli.rs:84`, `:174` and `:179`).
- `use`: `use_tree` (`:371-419`).
- The link set and the shadow check: `Links` (`:434-561`) and `first_on_path` (`:565-570`).
- doctor's link check: `src/doctor.rs:167`, which calls `Links::report`.

## The differences already there

(a) The opt prefix. Pplr takes it from `--prefix` or the environment variable `PPLR_OPT_PREFIX` (`src/config.rs:23-24` and `:74`; `src/cli.rs:85`). devbin reads its config key `install.prefix` from its own config (devbin's `bin/.devbin/config.yaml:24-25`, read at `lib/cmd/use:167-169`).

(b) `use dev`. Pplr points the link at `target/release/pplr`, a build product found through `CHECKOUT`, the path `env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")` compiles into the binary (`src/install.rs:22` and `:387-397`). devbin points it at the checkout's `bin/devbin`, and refuses `use dev` and `use opt` outside the dev checkout (`_use_in_checkout`, `lib/cmd/use:113-119`, called at `:162` and `:166`).

(c) The refusals. Pplr's `use opt` and `use brew` refuse in different cases and words from devbin's (`src/install.rs:399-416` and `Links::to_brew` at `:520-561`, against devbin's `lib/cmd/use:165-204`).

## How to see it

Read the code above. For example, `pplr use opt` with `PPLR_OPT_PREFIX` unset refuses with "pplr use opt needs PPLR_OPT_PREFIX, the opt tree's one place" (`src/install.rs:403`), where devbin's `use opt` reads its prefix from its config.

## Severity

Medium. It is a consistency and maintenance defect, with no data or security risk: a maintainer meets a different switch in each tool, and every fix has to be made twice.

## Fix outline

When Pplr adopts devbin#0326, `pplr use`, `pplr install` and `pplr version` go, rather than being made to match devbin's, and with them the tree code in `src/install.rs` and `build.rs` (which stamps only `PPLR_SOURCE_COMMIT` and `PPLR_SOURCE_DIRTY`). In their place Pplr adopts devbin's `install:` block in `bin/.devbin/config.yaml` (its opt prefix, its link set and the contacts sidecar), the core's `--version` snippet, and the formula on `@@INSTALL@@`. The publish and the switch are then `bin/devbin install` and `bin/devbin use [dev|opt|brew]`, run in Pplr's checkout, and `pplr --version` prints T4's line from the core's stamp.

`bin/devbin doctor` checks the switch and the line, so those checks leave `pplr doctor`: `install_rows` (`src/doctor.rs:103-176`) checks the tree, the manifest against its files (T3), the version line (T4) and the link's shadow check (T5) from that code, and `signatures` (`:190-235`) picks its check by tree, so it changes with the tree code.

What names the verbs today changes with them: `WITHOUT_DATA` (`src/cli.rs:198`), and `PPLR_OPT_PREFIX` (`src/config.rs:23-24` and `:74`), which only `install` and `use` read; `bin/.devbin/cmd/t10-probe`, the T10 proof, which runs `pplr use` and `pplr version`; `docs/releasing.md` (lines 12 to 37, and 64) and the formula's caveats (`packaging/homebrew/pplr.rb:50-58`), which then name `bin/devbin use`; `README.md`'s `pplr version` section and its maintainer line (`:460-468`), which the binary embeds; `intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE.md:84`; and the tests that run the verbs (`tests/cli.rs`, `tests/pplr_core.bats`, `tests/test_helper.bash`). No golden names them.

`pplr version` predates the contract: it is the shell version's verb (CHANGELOG 1.0.1). So its removal is a ruled divergence, listed in its release's CHANGELOG section.

## Until Pplr adopts devbin#0326

- The working switch, `pplr use` and `pplr install`, stays, so the maintainer is never without one.
- No new verb is added.

## Acceptance

- `pplr use`, `pplr install` and `pplr version` are gone, with the tree code in `src/install.rs` and `build.rs`. `bin/devbin install` and `bin/devbin use [dev|opt|brew]`, run in Pplr's checkout, publish Pplr's opt tree and switch its link, from the one implementation in devbin's core.
- `pplr --version` prints T4's line from the core's stamp, and `bin/devbin doctor` checks the switch and the line.
- `docs/releasing.md` and the formula's caveats name `bin/devbin use`.
- This issue closes against devbin#0326, whose acceptance names it.
